name: read_plan
description: Read the plan document for a run. Returns the plan content plus a truncated flag and the total character count; content past the size cap is cut off with a truncation marker. By default reads the current run's plan; pass runId to read another run's plan. A run that has not written a plan returns an unavailable result.

runId.description: Optional run id (run-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS) whose plan to read. Omit it to read the current run's plan.
